description: Replaces the ordered network-interception rules for a page session.

urlPattern.description: URL match pattern for the request rule.

action.description: Whether matching requests should be blocked or explicitly allowed.

patterns.description: Interception rules to apply in order.

purpose.description: Describe why you are intercepting requests, e.g., blocking ad requests to improve performance

pageId.description: Page ID whose interception rules were replaced.

ruleCount.description: Number of active interception rules after replacement.

replaced.description: Whether the previous rule set was replaced.

ruleIds.description: Opaque IDs assigned to the active rules.

patternsSet.description: Number of URL patterns accepted by the browser session.

observation.description: Factual observation of the completed Action and its current visible result.
